items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: I didn't know him, I mean, I didn't know who was in the band at the, at the, at the French Opera House when he played C Cornette.

ctx.x: I just wanted to, we didn't have the machine on before. Yeah. And, uh, when your father was in the union, what kind of musicians were in the union then? Were they?

Well, the Spora band, you remember when you saw the picture of the Spora band? Mm-hmm. Well, he, he played, played out at the parks and stuff like that, see? Yeah. And then, uh, of course, I know, I didn't know him, I mean, I didn't know who was in the band at the, at the, at the French Opera House when he played C Cornette. Yeah. But, uh, that was before I was born, I think. Mm-hmm. Or something like that. I, I don't remember too much about them. No. I was too young. Well. Before I had, had any idea of, of even…
Well, I just wondered if they let the jazz musicians in the union, if they had any trouble getting in.
